data: isolated synthetic accounts and fixtures only
layout_rule: Each browser × viewport × locale × theme; overflow and clipped actionable controls, typography hierarchy and screenshots. Viewports are CSS dimensions, not physical panel claims.
journey_rule: Each browser at 1366x768 and 1920x1080; locale/theme parity on mapping and all new UI; retain exact per-case evidence.
zoom_rule: Each native browser, inspector/saved-library/account, both themes; actual browser control/readback, keyboard reachability. Browser unsupported exact levels remain explicit, never CSS substitution.

screen_reader.rule: Actual reader focus/announcement observations, not inferred accessible names.

physical_devices.rule: Execute available real-device saved/history flows; record model/OS/browser. No available device is an explicit unavailable prerequisite, never a synthetic pass.

result_policy: Every frozen cell records pass/fail/open plus artifact or exact missing prerequisite. Do not infer one browser from another.

history_cases.selection: Deterministic first pair adding an uncovered format, context, or protocol label from loadCorpus().pairs; excludes declared HTTP400. Coverage is per dimension, not every Cartesian combination.
